company: The Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited
revenue: JPY 5.28T (FY2013, Wikipedia infobox; latest brand-level figure not confirmed); parent group TTM JPY 11.48T (~USD 76B)
valuation: unknown for the insurer itself (wholly owned); parent Dai-ichi Life Group market cap JPY 6.73T (~USD 45B)
profitability: Profitable; parent group net income JPY 553B TTM
marketing_evidence: Large Japanese consumer brand advertiser (Disney tie-in advertising); domestic sports ties (knowledge)
rationale: Core life-insurance subsidiary of Dai-ichi Life Group (TSE 8750), a very large and profitable insurer; Japan-centric mass audience and a crowded financial-services category limit F1 fit despite Suzuka/B2B hospitality potential.

marketing_evidence: Trade-show and B2B brand marketing in Europe/Asia for ABC solar modules; no major sports deals found
rationale: Shanghai Aiko Solar (SHA 600732) is a multi-billion solar cell/module maker selling into Europe, Asia and Middle East; tech-efficiency story and F1 net-zero agenda offer a sustainability partner angle, but it is currently loss-making amid the solar price slump.

revenue: USD 22.2B (2023, Wikipedia infobox); TTM ~26.6B per stockanalysis (currency label unclear)
valuation: Market cap ~SGD 9.3B (~USD 7.2B); now listed as Jardine Matheson Southeast Asia Ltd (SGX C07)
profitability: Profitable: net income USD 1.28B (latest per stockanalysis); USD 3.7B (2023 infobox)

rationale: ~75%-owned Jardines vehicle holding Astra and Mercedes-Benz distribution across SE Asia; huge, profitable and with Singapore GP hospitality logic, but regional reach and the saturated automotive category weaken fit.

valuation: unknown at group level (chaebol, not one listed entity); holding SK Inc. plus listed affiliates incl. SK hynix (knowledge: combined well above USD 50B)
